alphatab.toggleAB: Toggle A/B against the reference score
alphatab.toggleLoop: Toggle loop over the selected bars
alphatab.config.companionEnabled: Run companion tool checks and report them in the Problems panel.
alphatab.config.companionPreset: Which companion toolchain to use. 'auto' detects a Piano-to-Guitar repository above the open file.
alphatab.config.companionRunOn: When to run the gate: on save, or only when invoked manually.
alphatab.config.companionTranspose: Semitones the arrangement sits above its source. Cannot be inferred, so it must be set per project. Null omits --transpose.
alphatab.config.companionGain: Gain stage passed to the playability check, which bounds how many notes may sound at once.
alphatab.config.companionWarningsAsError: Treat advisory playability warnings as hard failures.
alphatab.config.companionSnapOnSave: Run 'history.mjs snap' before each save. A hand edit in the editor is the one state the gate loop does not snapshot on its own. Off by default because it writes into your repository.
alphatab.config.syncCursor: Scroll the preview to the bar under the editor cursor as you move it.
alphatab.config.staveProfile: Which staves to render: notation, tablature, or both.
alphatab.config.layoutMode: Page layout (wraps into systems) or horizontal (one endless row).
alphatab.config.scale: Zoom factor for the rendered score.
alphatab.config.soundFonts: Absolute paths to additional .sf2 soundfonts. Only a small general-purpose bank ships with the extension; large instrument banks stay on your disk so the extension package stays small.
alphatab.config.defaultSoundFont: Label or path of the soundfont to select by default. Empty means the first available one.
alphatab.config.outputMode: Audio output path. AudioWorklet can fail to load inside a webview, so ScriptProcessor is the safe default. Changing this requires reopening the preview.
alphatab.config.renderDebounceMs: Delay before re-rendering after an edit, in milliseconds.
alphatab.config.abPartner: File name pair used to find the A/B counterpart of the open file. If the open file matches one entry, the sibling named after the other entry becomes the reference score.
